changelog.summary: Add a portable read-only Unraid 7.2+ Module using the official GraphQL API and core-owned API-key injection.
entries: Preserve the Unraid Module ID, slug, configuration keys, view permission, Page path, and Widget IDs.
Expose bounded host, API version, resource, array, parity, disk, share, Docker, and VM monitoring.
Keep the API key opaque to Module code and inject it only inside NAD core's exact /graphql POST scope.
Retain useful GraphQL data when sibling fields fail and report only sanitized error paths.

preserves: config keys server_host, scheme, port, api_key
